multipleAttacks.name: Multiple Attacks
multipleAttacks.description: On an attack turn, this Cat may attack again and again for as long as it survives.

alwaysWin.name: Defeats Any Creature
alwaysWin.description: This Dog also wins the battles it starts against another Dog. It still loses to a Chicken.

seeEverything.name: Opponent Must Have All Face-Up Cards
seeEverything.description: Every card on the opponent's field flips face up.
